postVerificationRepair.finding: Fresh-install launch crash, then a save failure. The Android auto-backup restored navigator-secure-prefs.xml after the uninstall while the Keystore master key was destroyed; EncryptedSharedPreferences.create threw AEADBadTagException; the first file-only reset left the process prefs cache holding the corrupt keyset.
postVerificationRepair.fix: The key store uses a versioned v2 prefs file; an unreadable/restored keyset clears the cached legacy + current prefs (Context.deleteSharedPreferences), deletes the files and the default Keystore alias, and recreates; load/has/save are exception-safe (save returns Boolean); android:allowBackup=false.
postVerificationRepair.evidence: The fixed APK launches with no AndroidRuntime crash; the Setup renders; a non-secret test value saved (the v2 file written) — the owner then replaced it with the real keys.
